description: This file defines the class SyncInboundEmailAccountsSubActionHandler which handles sub-actions related to synchronizing inbound email accounts in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for managing email account synchronization, fetching email headers via IMAP, processing email IDs, and outputting results. The class interacts with the database, email beans, and IMAP connections, encapsulating the logic for inbound email sync operations.

classes.name: SyncInboundEmailAccountsSubActionHandler
classes.description: Handles sub-actions for syncing inbound email accounts, including initialization, rendering forms, performing synchronization, handling IMAP errors, and interacting with email beans and the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler and executes the requested sub-action based on request parameters.

methods.name: getRequestedSubAction
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the sub-action requested via the $_REQUEST['method'] parameter.

methods.name: action_Index
methods.description: Default action that displays the main inbound email accounts form.

methods.name: getInboundEmailRows
methods.description: Fetches all active, non-deleted inbound email account records from the database.

methods.name: getEmailBean
methods.description: Loads an Email bean by ID.

methods.name: getInboundEmailBean
methods.description: Loads an InboundEmail bean by ID.

methods.name: action_Sync
methods.description: Performs synchronization of inbound email accounts, fetching email headers via IMAP, updating email beans, and handling errors; outputs status messages.

methods.name: handleIMAPErrors
methods.description: Checks for IMAP errors and alerts from the email connection and logs or outputs warnings accordingly.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Deletes the synchronization output file if it exists, handling any permission issues.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs a message to the sync output file, appending content.

methods.name: getIMAPUID
methods.description: Finds and returns the IMAP UID matching a message ID MD5 in headers.

methods.name: getEmailIdsOfInboundEmail
methods.description: Retrieves email IDs associated with an inbound email account, validating the ID.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Runs a SQL SELECT query and returns the result set as an array; throws an exception if no records are found.

methods.name: getEmailHeadersOfIMAPServer
methods.description: Connects to the IMAP server, retrieves email headers, and computes message ID MD5s, then closes the connection.

methods.name: getCompoundMessageIdMD5
methods.description: Generates a composite MD5 hash of the message ID and delivery address from email headers.

methods.name: isOrphanedEmail
methods.description: Checks whether an email is orphaned based on IMAP headers.

methods.name: getRequestedInboundEmailAccounts
methods.description: Gets an array of selected inbound email account IDs from request parameters, validated.
